definition: Acceptance journeys for BuriMunsi sign-in, members, M-Money SMS, Payments and member allocation.
controllerScope: BuriViewModel with platform, repository and gateway doubles. Device acceptance is recorded separately.

journeys.title: Sign-in and sign-out
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Actual sign-in provider, hardware and soft-keyboard submission, rotation during login, logout then another operator.

journeys.title: Home and unallocated shortcut
journeys.controllerCoverage: Payment and member counts, recent Payments and the Unallocated shortcut
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Compare Home counts and recent incoming and outgoing payments with the scoped records. Exercise empty, error, loading and offline states.

journeys.title: Payment search, filters, pagination and Back
journeys.controllerCoverage: One Payments list, incoming and outgoing directions, Allocated and Unallocated filters, pagination and Back
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Exercise two or more real pages, long names, Back/rotation/process death and keyboard dismissal.

journeys.title: Payment details and raw M-Money SMS
journeys.controllerCoverage: Recorded payment details and authorized Admin access to retained raw SMS
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Verify the parsed amount and direction, original SMS, references, times and Admin-only raw evidence access.

journeys.title: Allocate a payment to a group member
journeys.controllerCoverage: Same-group selection, current payment version and original idempotency key
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Allocate an Unallocated payment and observe Allocated and the selected member. Interrupt the response and verify an exact retry changes the original payment once.

journeys.title: Member enrollment and unsaved changes
journeys.controllerCoverage: Keep editing/discard; invalid name blocked; explicit enrollment clears draft
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Validate provider identity rules, duplicate membership, dirty-panel Back/swipe/Escape, IME and accessible errors.

journeys.title: Member details and lifecycle
journeys.controllerCoverage: Scoped member details, group membership and authorized lifecycle actions
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Exercise member and group access boundaries, lifecycle controls and access revocation.

journeys.title: Profile, passcode and reauthentication
journeys.controllerCoverage: Nested panel Back; passcode command clears session and panels
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Test real PIN rotation, wrong current PIN, process death with credentials present and foreground reauthentication.

journeys.title: Staff account and removal confirmation
journeys.controllerCoverage: Contextual removal confirmation; cancel preserves edit; save returns to list
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Test real authority boundaries, staff revocation, last-admin safeguards and TalkBack focus return.

journeys.title: Admin SMS consent and sync
journeys.controllerCoverage: Profile-based Admin authority, Android SMS access, pending raw SMS and sync recovery
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Grant and revoke SMS permission for the signed-in Admin. Verify background and power-off catch-up with an eligible carrier message, and confirm Staff has no SMS access.

journeys.title: SMS filter, original evidence and access revocation
journeys.controllerCoverage: Retained raw SMS and parse results under the authorized Admin scope, with access cleared on revocation
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Verify raw retention and source access for supported, malformed and duplicate M-Money SMS. Confirm duplicate SMS does not create a second payment.

journeys.title: Background, offline recovery and no replay
journeys.controllerCoverage: Foreground guard; blocked navigation until validation; recovery does not replay commands
journeys.deviceAcceptance: Test process restart, offline cache expiry, return from Account, keystore restore failure and an interrupted member allocation.
